posts.meta_description:
173K likes, 3,737 comments - tamannaahspeaks on January 22, 2026: "This is TAMANNAAH FINE JEWELLERY.

This isn’t about collecting pieces.
It’s about finding the ones that stay.

Designed for people who don’t wait for occasions, but live fully in between them.
Jewellery that slips into the everyday, carried from morning light to evening glow.

There’s a certain casual glamour in that.
Effortless. Unforced. Personal.

Some jewellery announces itself.
Others, just settle in.

Not everything precious needs a moment.
Some things earn their place slowly.

Soon, we open the doors to THE APARTMENT in Mumbai, our flagship store imagined like a home.
A space where gold, light, and movement come together, and fine jewellery feels familiar, expressive, and lived in.

Come discover jewels that don’t ask to be saved.
They’re already meant to stay.

Beyond the Occasion.
Debut collection live now. Website link in bio. 

Shoot Location courtesy - @westinmumbaipowai".

33K likes, 374 comments - tamannaahspeaks on October 22, 2026: "Bangalore, we’re coming your way! ❤️

Delhi marked the beginning of our journey with @tajhotels, and now, it’s Bangalore’s turn with our all new Chandelier Collection - for your eyes first!

@tamannaahfinejewellery is coming to Khazana at @tajwestend on 26th October, and I’ll be there in person to walk you through the experience and introduce you to the world of TFJ.

One city at a time, we’re making the world of TFJ a little more accessible.

See you soon, Bangalore! ✨".

posts.meta_description:
109K likes, 1,244 comments - tamannaahspeaks on October 16, 2026: "You know I’m always up for a good stack. This look was all about mixing pieces I keep going back to, but in a whole new avatar…

I layered 2 varying lengths of Flick Chains with my foundation being the Rivières necklace. Paired with my everyday stack of rings and finished with my favourite Flick Bracelets from @tamannaahfinejewellery 

Sometimes, it’s the pieces you wear on repeat that end up bringing a new look together in the best way 

And this black chiffon and lace gothic moment from @eliesaabworld x @hm was just the perfect base to build on 🖤".

407K likes, 2,499 comments - tamannaahspeaks on October 12, 2026: "Through soaring bhajans, stories of Maa and a vivid journey through the mountains to Vaishno Devi, @preetypathania15 makes you experience devotion, not just hear it. With every song, every story and every beat, you can almost feel the climb, the sacred paths unfolding and the pilgrimage carrying you deeper within.

There’s something beautiful about this duality. The music rises, the energy moves through the room and the atmosphere pulses with devotion - yet, somewhere within, a deep stillness begins to unfold. All that sound and movement draw you inward, guiding you back to your centre, back to yourself.

Five hours of music, prayer and surrender that felt like a single, timeless moment. Jai Mata Di ❤️".
